svg.title: MISWAY Drift 3D set design blueprint v2
svg.desc: Candidate layout-improved 2D blueprint for the Drift 3D world. This proposal widens the planning frame to improve separation between eras, split New Signal into clearer subclusters and keep the same 24 tracks and era assignments.

g.text: v2: larger cave mouth + lambda gate + brighter backplate
v2: canals, robot crowd, jazz alley, metro / office pressure
v2: summit, jump, travel, choice, fading line, open breath
v2: comfort loop, hidden seam, zero, time fracture, color return
v2: three island clusters, void gaps, gold / silver / shadow contrast

g.title: A WALK IN ZEELAND — Birth Yard — anchor
MINUIT MOINS CINQ — Older Shadows — track
HOLD THE LIGHT — New Signal — anchor
LE MONDE S'ENDORT — New Signal — track

g.text: solid mass = landmark scaffold / set piece
dashed band = corridor that must stay open
larger ring = node protection / no tall props
micro icon = track-level scenic cue around each node
the v2 layout uses wider voids and stronger separation
city shard -> tall prism / wall fragment
field row -> low strip / stem / band
If the map reads only as color, it fails.
If the user sees places and corridors, it can be extruded.
The SVG is a candidate blueprint, not a poster.
